lead_raw_text:
The structure of ZnInS₂ adopts the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with a 16-atom unit cell (Zn₄In₄S₈) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for In and S centers, each with four geometric neighbors, and tetrahedral Zn centers coordinated by four S neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between In and S tetrahedra, between In tetrahedra, and between S tetrahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
